tips.text: Collect the Argon Crystals last, after Salvage, Cryotic and Oxium; they are the only input that decays.
Start the Nami Skyla and Masseter research back to back and gather the Foundry materials while the timers run.
Research in a clan you founded; a joined clan with an absent leader or no research permission blocks it.
Players treat it as solid but unremarkable Mastery fodder and move on to Masseter Prime.
